item.title: Syslogic launches NVIDIA Jetson AGX Thor rugged computer
item.summary: Syslogic has launched a rugged edge AI computer based on NVIDIA’s Jetson AGX Thor platform, targeting sensor fusion in autonomous machines, mobile robots and industrial vehicles. The RML A5AGX combines high AI processing performance with interfaces for cameras, LiDAR, radar and vehicle sensors.
